task.title: Advance source-ingest to autonomous durable ingest pipeline
task.summary_zh: 把 source-ingest 從接收 already-fetched records 的 deployable wrapper 推進成 baseline autonomous ingest pipeline：支援配置型 connector fetch job，持久化 source/evidence refs、水位、audit、DLQ，並補 smoke 覆蓋。
acceptance: service can trigger configured connector fetch without caller supplied already fetched records
ingest run persists source records watermarks audit actions and DLQ replay
source and evidence refs are durable and queryable by downstream consumers
compose or smoke verifies autonomous ingest happy path and failure replay
